consumer: The frontend map-view renderer, asking what terrain/furniture glyph the GUI would DISPLAY for each nearby tile including remembered out-of-LOS tiles.
scope: Per-tile displayed view over the nearby map region honoring tile memory/seen state (what the GUI would draw), not raw current world state.
decisive_source: Standing-context class table (D vs S): D is the GUI's formatted/filtered view that may lag raw state, while write_tiles in src/arcopolis_export.cpp reads m.ter/m.furn, the raw authoritative S value.
divergence: A tile the player previously saw as t_floor then left LOS, whose terrain changed out of view (e.g. smashed to t_floor_rubble); the map view should display the remembered t_floor, but raw m.ter reports t_floor_rubble.
